mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_chat ( stock_code, member_id, content, chart_price ) VALUES ( #{stockCode}, #{memberId}, #{content}, #{chartPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.chat_id, c.stock_code, c.member_id, m.nickname, c.content, c.chart_price, c.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_at, '%H:%i') AS create_at_str FROM stock_chat c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY c.create_at DESC, c.chat_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.chat_id, c.stock_code, c.member_id, m.nickname, c.content, c.chart_price, c.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_at, '%H:%i') AS create_at_str FROM stock_chat c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.stock_code = #{stockCode} AND c.chat_id < #{beforeChatId} ORDER BY c.create_at DESC, c.chat_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
